sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.683 of 2009 pending on the file of learned SDJM, Angul, arising out of Angul P.S. Case No.103 of 2009 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468, 473, 475 and 34 of IPC.
3.

It is submitted by the learned counsel that taking into account the nature of allegations and the release of the co-accused vide order dated 16.02.2010 in BLAPL No.20234 of 2009, on the ground of parity learned counsel for the Petitioner seeks pre-arrest bail.
4. The allegations against the present Petitioner is of conniving with the co-accused and preparing of forged certificates.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

6. Taking into account the nature of allegations and the release of the co-accused, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedent of similar nature.
